caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers set against a plain, off-white background. The chest is rectangular and rests on four short, curved legs. It features a total of five drawers: three smaller, horizontal drawers at the top and four larger, equally-sized drawers beneath them. Each drawer is equipped with two gold-colored, oval-shaped handles, and the smaller top drawers each have a single matching round knob. The wood is rendered in various shades of brown, showing a grainy texture with lighter and darker patches. The surfaces of the chest have subtle highlights and shadows to suggest depth and three-dimensionality. The background is empty and unadorned, and there is a small signature reading "Henry Meyers" located in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest
